name: s2a
what: the probe design of S2.1 to S2.4 (docs/s2_plan.md, section 5): one slice of LUT RAM and one slice of shift registers behind eight registers on M_AXI_GP0

COUNT.read: a counter of FCLK0, free running

RAM_ADDR.write: the address of the four LUT RAMs, for reading and for writing

RAM_DATA.read: the four outputs at that address, bit k from RAM k
RAM_DATA.write: one write of bit k into RAM k at that address

SRL_ADDR.write: the address of the four shift registers' outputs

SRL_DATA.read: the four outputs at that address, bit k from shift register k (address a: the bit shifted in a+1 shifts ago; before any shift, bit a of what was loaded)
SRL_DATA.write: one shift of bit k into shift register k

WRITES.read: RAM writes since the design was loaded (bits 15..0) and shifts (bits 31..16)

ram.positions: not constrained: Vivado puts the four on the site's four LUT positions in an order of its own and keeps no position given to them (pl/s2a/s2a.xdc). Which memory is on which position is in the build's record (pl/s2a/build.json), and is taken from there.

sites_chosen: by hand, from pl/s2a/slicem_sites.txt, under one rule: no site of a column of sites numbered below 10 (those are the columns zynq-fabricmap's carrier constrained or measured; section 12, point 5). Which of the others, and which row, is arbitrary.

clock.source: FCLK0 as the boot loader leaves it (50 MHz on 17A6), through a BUFG
